messages.plaintextBody:
Tom, Sarah,

The Tribunal has sent through Geoff's ET1 (case 2601839/2026) - claims are s.103A automatic unfair dismissal, s.98 unfair dismissal, s.47B detriment and age discrimination, as expected. The ET3 response is due by 17 March. Given we expect to settle, I'll prepare protective Grounds of Resistance to file in good time. Diarised.

Elena

Elena Marchetti
Associate | Employment
Whitfield Carter LLP
